acip: DNGOS PO DANG MI 'GAL BA DANG 'GAL BA'I MTSAN NYID YOD DE, KHYOD DNGOS PO DANG MI 'GAL BA DANG THA DAD, KHYOD YANG YIN, DNGOS PO DANG MI 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MI SRID PA DE YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: dngos po dang mi 'gal ba dang 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid yod de, khyod dngos po dang mi 'gal ba dang tha dad, khyod yang yin, dngos po dang mi 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa mi srid pa de yin pa'i phyir
english: There does exist a definition for something which is contradictory to what is not contradictory to a working thing, because “That which is different from what is not contradictory to a working thing, and such that it is impossible for there to be any example of something which is both it, and also contradictory to a working thing” is just such a definition.
